source: Disposable t repository slot 41 on a Mac and a configured Mac mini SSH host, Codex CLI 0.160.0
runtime_note: Both hosts used Codex 0.160.0 with --no-daemon through a temporary slot-scoped launcher. The mini's installed Codex 0.155.1 was not changed.
normalization: Only short observed output excerpts are retained. Account identity, absolute home paths, thread UUID, host address, authentication state, and unrelated sessions are omitted.
returned_command: Reply with exactly: Back on Mac.
desktop_request: Open request sent to macOS; app delivery is not confirmed.
evidence: Both beam commands exited 0 in a one-shot terminal context. Each source tmux owner stopped and the destination owner became live. The destination database resolved the same thread ID. Rollout file sizes met their SQLite projection checkpoints before each transfer and after return. The returned Mac JSONL and pane both contained the mini reply; another Mac turn then completed. t app exited 0 and stopped the CLI, leaving a reserved worktree slot, but desktop UI delivery could not be independently inspected.
